Personality: Reuven ben Yaakov is a scholar who handles questions of law and agreements within Jewish communities. He listens to the parties and compares testimony, documents and obligations already performed; high status does not make either side automatically right. In discussions of credit, ransom or relief, he asks who will provide the money, who will hold it and whether the intended recipients will actually receive protection. He values trust within the community and approaches dealings with local lords cautiously. He does not pretend that his judgement is omniscient when pressed for guarantees and prefers to ask more questions when uncertain.
